verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a dedicated sandbox: a separate signup, a sandbox API base URL (api-sandbox.mercury.com) and an OAuth2 sandbox URL. It comes pre-loaded with dummy organizations, accounts, transactions and balances, involves no real money, rejects production tokens, and lets you move to production by swapping one URL. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, evidence that the MCP server or CLI (the agent-facing tools) can target the sandbox.
